settings.heading: Repairs, for five years
settings.text: Free — seams, buttons, linings and moth holes. Post it back, or bring it to the counter at the back of the cutting room.

settings.heading: Hemming, whenever
settings.text: Free on anything we made, for as long as you own it. Trousers and coats, to the centimetre, in about a week.

settings.heading: Re-proofing and pressing
settings.text: Quoted first. A coat that has had three winters usually wants pressing rather than cleaning, and we will say so.

settings.heading: How do I send a garment in?
settings.text: Write to us with the order number. We reply with a prepaid insured label, and nothing is sent at your own risk.

settings.heading: What does a repair cost?
settings.text: Repairs and hemming are free for five years. Anything else is quoted before work starts, and we will say when a repair is not worth the money.

settings.heading: Do you work on garments you did not make?
settings.text: Yes, on the same terms: quoted first, and an honest answer about whether to do it at all.

settings.heading: Can a hemmed garment be let down again?
settings.text: Usually once, depending on the seam allowance we left. This is why hemmed garments are final sale, and we say it before you order.

settings.heading: Sending a garment back
settings.intro: The practical part. Anything not here, write to us and a person answers.

settings.heading: Ask about a repair
settings.intro: Tell us the order number and what happened. We reply within two working days, with a quote before anything is touched.
